count_definition: Count intrinsic expressive/executable coding systems, including textual/symbolic syntax, embodied/glyph/gesture grammar, instruction/opcode/bytecode, policy/IR representation, and evidenced dual-role meta/game grammars. evidence_boundary.current_canonical_native_v2: 100/100 first-batch bodies have present-day canonical-native specification/conformance; this is engineering evidence, not historical-source identity.

priority.law: P0/P1 may run in parallel. Recover before rebuild; current authorised forward implementation may continue while exact historical source is sought, but must declare itself.
